/* ==============================================================
   v0.5.1 — MOBILE FIT + ASSET ORGANIZATION PASS
   ============================================================== */
html,body{width:100%;min-height:100%;margin:0;overscroll-behavior:none}
body{overflow:hidden;background:#05070a}
.screen{width:100%;min-height:100dvh}

/* Crimson now has a dedicated portrait menu composition. */
#menuScreen{
  width:100vw;
  height:100dvh;
  min-height:100dvh;
  background-size:cover;
  background-position:center center;
  background-repeat:no-repeat;
}
#menuScreen::before{
  background:
    linear-gradient(180deg,rgba(5,7,10,.10),rgba(5,7,10,.08) 44%,rgba(5,7,10,.43)),
    radial-gradient(circle at 50% 50%,rgba(5,7,10,.02),rgba(5,7,10,.25) 78%);
}

/* Entire combat experience fits inside one phone viewport. */
#battleScreen{
  width:100vw;
  height:100dvh !important;
  min-height:100dvh !important;
  max-height:100dvh !important;
  overflow:hidden !important;
}
#battleScreen .wrap{
  box-sizing:border-box;
  width:min(100vw,520px) !important;
  height:100dvh !important;
  max-height:100dvh !important;
  padding:env(safe-area-inset-top) 0 env(safe-area-inset-bottom) !important;
  margin:0 auto !important;
  display:flex !importa

.teamBody{padding:14px 12px calc(30px + env(safe-area-inset-bottom));max-width:620px;margin:auto}

.teamSlots{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(3,1fr);gap:9px;margin-bottom:16px}

<div id="teamScreen" class="screen">
  <header class="collectionHeader">
    <button id="teamBackBtn" class="collectionBack" aria-label="Back">‹</button>
    <div class="collectionTitle">EDIT TEAM<small>ACTIVE BATTLE SQUAD</small></div>
    <button id="teamHomeBtn" class="collectionHome" aria-label="Home">⌂</button>
  </header>
  <main class="teamBody">
    <div class="teamIntro">
      <b>Choose your active three.</b> Tap a slot, then tap an owned battle-ready fighter.
      Selecting a fighter already in another slot swaps their positions.
    </div>
    <section id="teamSlots" class="teamSlots" aria-label="Active team slots">
      <button class="teamSlot selected" data-team-slot="0" data-slot-label="SLOT 1"><img alt=""><span class="teamSlotName">—</span></button>
      <button class="teamSlot" data-team-slot="1" data-slot-label="SLOT 2"><img alt=""><span class="teamSlotName">—</span></button>
      <button class="teamSlot" data-team-slot="2" data-slot-label="SLOT 3"><img alt=""><span class="teamSlotName">—</span></button>
    </section>
    <div class="teamRosterTitle">OWNED FIGHTERS</div>
    <section id="teamCandidates" class="teamCandidates" aria-label="Battle-ready fighters"></section>
    <div class="teamActions">
      <button id="saveTeamBtn" class="saveTeamBtn">SAVE ACTIVE TEAM</button>
      <div id="teamSaved" class="teamSaved" aria-live="polite"></div>
    </div>
  </main>
</div>
